evidence.quote: Paulo post magnam iacturam passus est liber: abreptus est dialogus paene totus ... Ex libro ita decurtato duo exemplaria fluxerunt, quorum alterum progenuit Lugdunensem nostrum, alterum fons est et Palatini et Sirmondiani cum Parisino.
Sic factum est, ut Lugdunensis liber, qui est alterius familiae, in malis non raro consentiat cum foliis Thuaneis.
Hunc enim et Sirmondianum ex uno fonte derivatos diverso quidem ab eo exemplari, unde descriptus est Lugdunensis, communes utrique errores ostendunt
Decurtatus abrepto dialogo abiectisque homiliis, archetypus librorum LS | archetypus librorum PS | Lugdunensis membranaceus s. XI/XII | Parisinus ep. XXXIII | Sirmondianus (diagram garbled)

texts.notes: Stemma (p. XXVIII) garbled; placement of the papyrus is ambiguous: the text calls L 'alterius familiae' than the papyrus, yet says Florus' exemplar (ancestor of L, S) was of the same family as the Vita-author's codex, 'si non ipsum papyreum at cognatum papyreo'. Check the diagram on the page image. The papyrus overlaps only a few letters/homilies; for most letters the witnesses are L and S (an edition), so the operative split is L vs PS.

evidence.quote: Eorum tres ordines constituendi sunt, quorum primus et alter dignitate ab initio parum fuisse videntur diversi, tertius ab primo ut videtur derivatus multo est inferior.
Alterius ordinis β librorum, qui ad exemplar aliquod cum RF cognatum recedunt, quamvis nullus omnino sit usus in constituendis auctoris verbis
Bavarici libri ... alteram ordinis β classem constituunt interpolatam adscitis ordinis α libris maximeque eius classis ad quam pertinet F

texts.notes: No diagram; verbal only and hedged ('ut videtur'). Reading the derivation of ordo III from ordo I gives top split [ordo I + III + β] vs [ordo II = L]; but Peiper also says ordo I and II were of nearly equal worth and does not explicitly name a common sub-archetype. β (Germanici) descends from an RF-cognate exemplar but is contaminated from α; p (S. Victoris) mixes two families. Several sigla (K?, T, n vs N) need checking against the conspectus image (line ~19372).
